title: begin right after start stops at the claim push because start leaves the sprint's item files unstaged
goal: backlog.py start SP commits the item files it rewrites in one commit that names the sprint in KB-Work, whether or not --commit is passed, so the first begin of the sprint finds a clean tree and pushes its claims with no hand commit

run:
import sys, os, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base
r = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = r / bl_base.rel_dir(); d.mkdir(parents=True)
def g(*a): return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(r), *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
import shutil; shutil.copy("backlog.json", r / "backlog.json")
g("init", "-q"); g("config", "user.email", "t@example.com"); g("config", "user.name", "t")
def put(it): (d / (it["id"] + ".json")).write_text(bl_base.canonical(it), encoding="utf-8")
put({"id": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "sprint", "title": "s", "goal": "g one", "status": "draft", "gates": [{"id": "start", "kind": "blocking", "question": "q", "options": ["approve", "change", "cancel"], "recommendation": "approve", "answer": "approve", "by": "operator"}]})
for i in ("BG-bbbbbbbb", "ST-cccccccc"):
    put({"id": i, "kind": "bug" if i[0] == "B" else "story", "title": "t " + i, "goal": "g", "status": "draft", "sprint": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "touches": ["_tools/zz.py"], "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}]})
put({"id": "ST-dddddddd", "kind": "story", "title": "review", "goal": "g", "status": "draft", "sprint": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "review": True, "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}]})
g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-q", "-m", "plan")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", str(r), "start", "SP-aaaaaaaa"], capture_output=True, text=True)
dirty = g("status", "--porcelain", "--", bl_base.rel_dir()).strip()
body = g("log", "-1", "--format=%B")
n = int(g("rev-list", "--count", "HEAD").strip())
ok = p.returncode == 0 and not dirty and n == 2 and "KB-Work: SP-aaaaaaaa" in body
print("start committed its item files in one commit" if ok else "start left them: exit %s dirty=%r commits=%s" % (p.returncode, dirty[:120], n))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

commit always and refuse outside git

gates.reason: a root with no repository keeps starting, as before
gates.answer: commit whenever the root is a git work tree

notes: Met again in SP-pww4aqis on 2026-11-09: the first begin after start stopped at the claim push on 13 unstaged item files; committed by hand. Premise (planner, 2026-11-09, base): reproduced. Check 0 plants a git repo with an approved sprint and three draft items and runs start: it exits 0 and leaves four modified item files, one commit in the repo. start already takes --commit (commit_written at the end of cmd_start in bl_plan.py); the skill's start step runs it without. Choice settled in the goal: start commits by default, so no flag.
